test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

S O _ T _ S _ F _ Y _ O F T _ _ O F T Y

options.text: F Y O T S Y S
S O T T Y FS
O F S T Y F O
Y F O T S Y T

solution:
Given series: S O _ T _ S _ F _ Y _ O F T _ _ O F T Y

Option 1) F Y O T S Y S → S O __**F**__ T __**Y**__ S __**O**__ F __**T**__ Y __**S**__ O F T __**Y**__ __**S**__ O F T Y → (It follows the pattern of: SOFTY - SOFTY - SOFTY - SOFTY)

Option 2) S O T T Y FS → S O __S__ T __O__ S __T__ F __T__ Y __Y__ O F T **__F__** __S__ O F T Y → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) O F S T Y F O → S O __O__ T __F__ S __S__ F __T__ Y __Y__ O F T __F__ __O__ O F T Y → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) Y F O T S Y T → S O __Y__ T __F__ S __O__ F __T__ Y __S__ O F T __Y__ __T__ O F T Y → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
